text:
Rita Patel: Quick sync: marketplace demo next Thurs needs a lightweight telemetry plan. Goal: show runtime->Datadog trace linkage without sending user text and without high cardinality. Need sampling strategy, attribute naming, and a demo script for SIs.

Leo Gomez: Agree. Two prongs: 1) collector-side sampling to keep volume down, 2) payload hygiene (redact prompt, hash request ids). Also recommend rps-based adaptive sampler so demo doesn't flood Datadog during load tests.

Nora Singh: For the marketplace tile we should default to a 1% probabilistic sampler + a 10% on-error capture (status >= 5xx) to help surface issues. That keeps costs low but surfaces failures. We'll document how to flip to 100% in enterprise installs.

Jules Carter: Dashboard naming and vars: use attributes names that are stable and prefixed: redwood.model_name, redwood.model_version, redwood.request_hash, redwood.latency_ms, redwood.seq_range, redwood.gpu_shard. Keeping a 'redwood.' prefix avoids collisions with customer spans.

Rita Patel: Love the prefix idea. Also want to bucket seq_range into small/medium/large for heatmap granularity. Proposed: small=<128, medium=128-512, large=>512.

Leo Gomez: Collector OTLP example (placeholder) to share with SIs: 

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
processors:
  attributes/redwood_hygiene:
    actions:
      - key: prompt
        action: delete
      - key: request_id
        action: hash
      - key: sequence_length
        action: insert 
        value: ">=0"
  tail_sampling:
    policy_config:
      - name: error_boost
        type: probabilistic
        sample_percentage: 10
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 1
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: "<DD_API_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/redwood_hygiene, probabilistic_sampler, tail_sampling]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Nora Singh: Note: the above is illustrative. We'll add a tiny attribute processor that converts sequence_length to seq_range (small/medium/large) to reduce cardinality. Also drop logits entirely.

Jules Carter: For the demo script: step 1) show overview heatmap filtered to redwood.model_name; step 2) click into a spike -> show trace, show request_hash mapping to logs; step 3) show gated Ops dashboard (enterprise) with token-level histograms. We'll include canned queries so partners can import the dashboard JSON.

Rita Patel: Embargo check: Marketing wants to align announcement with partner PR week of 2026-04-06. Can legal confirm the telemetry one-liner? Suggested copy: "Telemetry exports aggregated runtime metrics and hashed identifiers only; no customer input is transmitted."

Leo Gomez: Legal okayed that wording with minor tweak. I'll post final one-liner later.

deploy-bot: Demo slot tentative: 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. Upload path: /shared/marketplace/demo-assets/4125550000 by 2026-04-01 23:59 UTC.

Nora Singh: Action items: (1) Nora -> prepare collector snippet with seq_range transform (due Mon) (2) Jules -> starter dashboard JSON + import instructions (due Tue) (3) Rita -> demo script + PR calendar check (due Mon) (4) Leo -> sample sampler config + cost estimate (due Tue).

Jules Carter: I'll also add a short note for SI partners explaining how to flip gating on the marketplace tile and where to store the dashboard JSON in partner S3.

Rita Patel: If anyone finds gaps in attribute names vs Datadog recommended tags, please flag now. Otherwise we proceed with this plan.

Leo Gomez: Flag: ensure gpu_shard hashing is deterministic per pool but salted per-customer to avoid cross-tenant correlation. We'll document the salt handling.

Rita Patel: Good call. Thanks everyone. I'll post the Mon updates and the demo script here when ready.
